bridge.title: Negotiation Bridge
bridge.intro: You arrived from a negotiation page on the main site. Here each term becomes an aspect in the discussion, and the consensus tool will help you formulate a middle formula — which will return for approval in the regular vote.
bridge.invalid: The link you arrived with is invalid or has expired. Return to the negotiation page and try again.
bridge.locked: Opening a bridge discussion is open to registered users only.
bridge.errorCreate: Failed to create bridge discussion. Make sure the server is connected and try again.

bar.title: Bridge discussion on {title}
bar.hint: When agreement forms, select the summary proposal and return it to the negotiation page on the main site.
bar.noSolution: No middle proposal yet — allow one to be created with "Propose middle formula".
bar.finalize: ✅ Sign the decision and send it back
bar.finalizeHint: Signing stores the decision on the discussion itself — every member sees it on the source card, even without the link. Final approval still runs through the regular vote round.
bar.finalizeError: Saving the decision failed. Please try again.
bar.resolvedAt: Signed on {date} and sent back to the source card.
